# Contributor Utilities Licensing Record

Recorded 2026-10-12 from the bundled stream source notices. The inspected stream
files offer Apache License 2.0 or LGPL, with copyright notices including Isidor
Zeuner and Jos van den Oever. Preserve those notices and the existing offers.
[LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt](LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt) provides the Apache license text

The gzip stream wrappers call zlib; they do not change zlib's licensing.

SDK/NDK zlib is an external dependency, not that preserved implementation.

Contributor streams are not included in the current binary build.
